headline: The Fed Held, The Bond Market Called The Bluff, and Oil Did The Rest
summary: Wall Street sold off hard on Wednesday even after the Fed held rates steady, as three dissenters wanting a hike, a 30-year yield at its highest in years, and a 7% jump in oil combined into one messy tape. Microsoft and Meta reported after the bell, one delivered the AI proof-point investors wanted, the other reopened the capex debate.
